title: Minimum Difference in Sums After Removal of Elements
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums consisting of 3 * n elements, you can remove any subsequence of exactly n elements.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums consisting of 3 * n elements, you can remove any subsequence of exactly n elements. The remaining 2 * n elements will be divided into two parts, each containing n elements. The sum of the elements in the first part is sumfirst, and the sum of the elements in the second part is sumsecond. The difference between these sums is sumfirst - sumsecond. Your task is to find the minimum possible difference between the sums of the two parts after removing n elements.
constraints: len(nums)=3*n and exactly n elements must be removed without changing remaining order.
The first n kept values form the left sum and the last n kept values form the right sum.
Return the minimum possible left sum minus right sum; values may reach 100,000.
reference_solution:
def minimum_sum_difference_after_removal(nums):
    import heapq
    n=len(nums)//3
    left=[0]*len(nums);heap=[-value for value in nums[:n]];heapq.heapify(heap)
    total=sum(nums[:n]);left[n-1]=total
    for index in range(n,2*n):
        total+=nums[index];heapq.heappush(heap,-nums[index]);total+=heapq.heappop(heap)
        left[index]=total
    right=[0]*len(nums);heap=nums[2*n:];heapq.heapify(heap)
    total=sum(heap);right[2*n]=total
    for index in range(2*n-1,n-1,-1):
        total+=nums[index];heapq.heappush(heap,nums[index]);total-=heapq.heappop(heap)
        right[index]=total
    return min(left[index-1]-right[index] for index in range(n,2*n+1))
